questions.question: The spec promises a '2-level drill' (group → sub-lines → transactions), but the statement we shipped mirrors the workbook's outline at ARBITRARY depth — Admin Expenses is three levels deep. So clicking an Actual at the top of Admin has two levels below it, not one. What should clicking an aggregate Actual do?
options: Any aggregate opens its leaf sub-lines (Recommended)
Strictly one level down each click
Every aggregate goes straight to transactions
questions.chosen: Any aggregate opens its leaf sub-lines (Recommended)

questions.question: The statement's acceptance criterion is that line items foot EXACTLY to the clicked Actual. But if someone re-uploads the July actuals while a statement is on screen, the drill would read the newly active batch and no longer foot. What should the drill read?
options: Always read the currently active batch
Pin to the batch, and block the drill if it was replaced

questions.question: The statement spec says a bundled transactions sheet arrives 'with the drill-down capability', but the drill-down spec itself describes no export at all. Should this story include exporting transactions to Excel?
options: Yes — include a transactions sheet in the export
Yes, but only the currently drilled line items
